Verify Unidrv catalogs through WinTrust

Use the existing WinTrust signer/thumbprint gate for signed catalog files instead of relying on PowerShell Get-AuthenticodeSignature object parsing, which returned empty status/thumbprint on Windows Server 2025 CI.
